SAID PLAINLY

What it does not do yet.

SMS in India needs sender and template registration under the telecom rules, which you complete once. RCS reaches only phones and networks that support it. Messages are charged per message at the published rates. The public roadmap says what is shipped, rolling out and not yet.

QUESTIONS

What jewellers ask.

Does SMS marketing still work for jewellers?

For short, certain messages, yes: payment received, order ready, instalment due. For offers and conversations, WhatsApp usually gets more response.

What is RCS messaging for a jewellery shop?

RCS is the richer successor to SMS: images, buttons and a verified business name inside the phone’s messaging app. It works on supported phones and networks.

Do push notifications work for jewellery stores?

They work for people who opted in on your website or app, and cost nothing per message. They suit new collections and rate alerts.

Which channel should I use?

WhatsApp for conversation, SMS for certainty, push for free reach, email for detail. One campaign can use all four.
